title: Transverse Back Kneading
summary: Both hands gently displace the muscle mass in opposite directions across its long axis.
goal: Vary the kneading pattern and gently mobilize larger areas of muscle tissue.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of transverse back kneading without text labels.
startingPosition: The person lies face down. Warm the area first and place both hands over the muscle mass.
instructions: Place the hands on opposite sides of the selected muscular area.
Gently shift the tissue toward you with one hand and away with the other.
Release pressure without abruptly losing contact.
Move to the neighboring area and repeat.
Do not perform the movement directly over the spine or bony borders.
direction: Alternating displacement of soft tissue across the muscle mass.
tips: Use the palm and fingers together.
Keep the movement small and comfortable.
mistakes: Twisting only the skin instead of soft tissue.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute pain, recent injury, significant inflammation, damaged skin, or when touch increases symptoms. Seek qualified professional advice when uncertain.
